liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Shakedown Street** (4 reviews): Reviewer ranks it among the coolest 1970s versions, with funky Brent and Bobby seemingly teasing the Ghostbusters theme; Reviewer singles it out as a must-hear part of the show [12][13][15][18]
- **I Know You Rider** (1 review): Reviewer was hooked for good by the time the band moved from China Cat into Rider [23]
- **Passenger** (1 review): Reviewer calls this version extremely hot [12]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer recommends the Estimated Prophet into Eyes pairing as a must-hear [13]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer finds it very fast, following Estimated Prophet [12]
- **Wharf Rat** (1 other source): This track includes a soundboard and audience patch [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **Crowd / Take A Step Back / Weir's Quiz #1**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **Crowd / Tuning / Weir's Quiz #2**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1979-10-31.aud.glassberg.motb.87523.sbeok.flac24** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 191 min [1]. Said about its sound: From early in the second-set track 15 to the end, the left channel was much quieter and was boosted [1]
- **gd1979-10-31.nakcm700-glassberg.motb39.egert-sirmick.86239.flac16**: source not stated; 22 songs; 191 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Crowd enthusiasm nearly drowns the music and vocals at the start of China Cat [2]
- **gd1979-10-31.sbd-bertha.ashley.17360.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4.43/5 by 7 [3]. Said about its sound: The first set sounds like a different source than the second, and its channels were reversed and corrected [3]
- **gd1979-10-31.sonyECM.moskal.mandel.96606.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 171 min [4]. Said about its sound: Levels fluctuate throughout, with audience participation in spots, and a cut between disc 3 tracks 4 and 5 [4]
- **gd79-10-31.sbd-aud.shephard.9372.sbefail.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 169 min; rated 4.07/5 by 15 [9]. Said about its sound: In this matrix copy the first-set tracks are out of order and need rearranging; the band sounds tight [14]

## Around the show

- The crowd is lively, and Jerry can be heard pleading with them to move back [21]
- Reviewer finds Phil's stage banter funny [21]
- Reviewer, then 16, stood in the second row; far too many people crowded the floor [23]
- A tape flip falls after Weir asks his quiz question, so the answer is missing from this recording [1]
- Reviewer thinks this show is overshadowed by the preceding Cape Cod run and by the other two nights of this run [16]
- Reviewer rates it as good as 11-2-79 and maybe better overall than 11-1-79, though that night's Scarlet into Fire is unreal [16]
- Reviewer says the band always stepped things up for Halloween shows [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1979-10-31.aud.glassberg.motb.87523.sbeok.flac24**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by A. Egert and SIRMick; source: Nakamichi CM-700's > Sony TC-158SD > MAC [1]. Also: Another tape flip, during Drums, was crossfaded by the uploader [1]
- **gd1979-10-31.nakcm700-glassberg.motb39.egert-sirmick.86239.flac16**: taped by Barry Glassberg; transferred by A. Egert; source: Nakamichi CM700's > Sony TCD5 > MAC 50ft. DFC Hand-Held [2]. Also: A matrix with a soundboard source was made for 0:29 to 1:36 of China Cat to lift the music; The soundboard used went from cassette master to reel, DAT and CD [2]
- **gd1979-10-31.sbd-bertha.ashley.17360.shnf**: transferred by Jay Ashley; source: Bertha Remaster of a combination of soundboard and audience sources see info file [3]. Also: Remastered on April 3, 2003 with a custom dual-DAW setup nicknamed Bertha, processing each set separately [3]
- **gd1979-10-31.sonyECM.moskal.mandel.96606.flac16**: taped by Gerry Moskal; transferred by Brian Mandel; source: Sony Stereo ECM -->SONY TCD126 Location: unknown; [4]. Also: Taper Gerry's reels were transferred in the mid-1980s during social tape trading [4]
- **gd79-10-31.sbd-aud.shephard.9372.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard and Audience composite [9]. Also: Reviewer says the soundboard portions of this show have circulated for a shorter time than other nights; Set 1 came from a soundboard cassette master, then reel, DAT and CD; set 2 went from cassette master to cassette, DAT, CD; Reviewer says this tour has no reel masters, only cassette masters [16][17]
